chunks: God does not like that evil should be spoken of in speech except by one who has been wronged. And ever is Allah Hearing and Seeing.
ai.seo_question: When does Allah allow loud speech about evil or complaints?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse distinguishes between mere loudness and the substantive right of the *mazlūm* (wronged) to voice their grievance, emphasizing that Allah’s displeasure targets the *quality* of the speech rather than its volume. It serves as a foundational principle for social conduct, encouraging modesty in speech while validating the legal and spiritual right of the oppressed to seek justice, under the watchful eye of the All-Hearing and All-Knowing.
